Lab 8: Parking Garage Management System
This lab walks you through the analysis, design and implementation of a small parking garage system.
This part builds on the previous one, so keep your earlier notes at hand and reuse the names you chose. Read the whole part before you start writing anything. The garage in this lab is a fictional multi-level building next to the campus library; it has three levels, and each level has spots for motorcycles, compact cars and large cars. Drivers take a ticket at the entrance barrier and pay at the exit barrier before leaving. The examples in the lecture slides use a simpler garage with only one level, which is a good starting point for your own thinking. Discuss your ideas with your lab partner, sketch them on paper first, and only then move on to the computer.
Part A: Requirements analysis

Identify the actors that interact with the garage system.
For each actor, describe at least two goals in one sentence each.
Part B: Domain model

Your domain model must cover at least the following concepts:
Levels and parking spots of different sizes
Vehicles and their size classes
Tickets with entry and exit times
Payments for a ticket
Part C: Implementation
This part builds on the previous one, so keep your earlier notes at hand and reuse the names you chose. Read the whole part before you start writing anything. The examples in the lecture slides use a simpler garage with only one level, which is a good starting point for your own thinking. Discuss your ideas with your lab partner, sketch them on paper first, and only then move on to the computer.
Implement the domain model in an object-oriented language of your choice.
At minimum, your program needs to support:
Assigning the smallest free spot that fits a vehicle
Issuing a ticket when a vehicle enters
Calculating the fee from the entry and exit times
Freeing the spot when the vehicle leaves
The fee rules should be easy to change without editing the ticket class.

Your command-line interface should support these operations:
Park a vehicle
Remove a vehicle and print its fee
Show the free spots on each level

Use only the standard library of your language.
Submit the source code as a ZIP file.
